name: Elves Brener
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian lightweight from Chute Boxe Diego Lima (17-6, age 29), 4-3 in the UFC. He knocked out Josiah Harrell in R1 in September after a three-fight skid (Orolbai, Joel Alvarez R3 KO, Ribovics).

how_they_fight.Striking: Four knockouts in our data, two of them in R3.
how_they_fight.Grappling: A submission threat: eleven submissions, eight in R1.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped once (Alvarez, R3); five decision losses.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has late finishes and has gone the distance often.

concerns: Five decision losses: gets out-pointed by busier fighters

sources.author: Sourav Chakraborty
sources.title: 23-second UFC finisher reportedly draws Islam Dulatov in Saudi Arabia
